digest.component_or_area: external integration tests / bridge reconciler output contract
propositions: The canonical sync route deliberately suppresses OK: stdout output and gates it on route not in {preview, sync}, emitting only BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr instead per the documented contract.
Two DC harness test assertions in test_reconcile_pass.py stale after commit c87afedba8 re-pointed cells at sync route and now incorrectly assert on OK: lines the sync route never prints.

BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone cannot be a zero-write idempotence assertion because the reconciler emits CONVERGED whether or not mutations were applied; proof requires RECON differ totals and batch_outcome line counts.

Test helper assertions must parse BRIDGE_STATE converged status plus zero RECON outbound_differ and inbound_differ totals plus zero RECON batch_outcome lines to correctly validate idempotence on the sync route.
Unit-testable parsing predicates moved to dependency-free module _bridge_output.py so the output contract can be validated in the unit lane without Jira, network, or credentials.
